node.title: Rate-half MCA support-wise affine-span compiler
node.closure: direction-separation removed by exact pair noncontainment
node.statement: In the affine-span MCA incidence theorem, global direction separation is unnecessary when every counted slope carries an exact same-support pair-noncontained witness. Any incident-normal rank failure either gives a nonzero codeword with at least K roots or makes the direction a codeword on that witness support; in the latter case subtracting it from the slope explanation also makes the base word a codeword there, contradicting noncontainment. The original affine-span bound therefore holds unchanged. Applied after whole-line global-core cancellation, it pays every shortened family through s=13 on KoalaBear and s=5 on Mersenne-31, removing the direction-list residual at those depths.
